Own and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs, RACI matrices, and governance trackers. Mentor junior coordinators and contribute to improving project coordination standards, templates, and working practices. We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Coordinator to lead coordination and governance across complex initiatives, with a strong focus on digital transformation, data and analytics programs, AI-enabled solutions, and enterprise delivery initiatives. This role requires someone who can independently manage project controls, drive stakeholder alignment, oversee execution tracking across multiple workstreams, and ensure strong delivery discipline. The Senior Project Coordinator will act as a key operational anchor across large and complex programs, while also mentoring junior team members and strengthening project coordination practices. The role is suited to someone who brings structure, visibility, and strong execution governance to fast-moving delivery environments.
